maxValidations.description: Amount a ticket can be validated (successfully scanned) on the rule. When 0 the ticket cannot be scanned.

maxValidationScope.description: Defines the scope of maxValidations. UNRESTRICTED: total limit across entire validity period, DAILY: limit resets each day, SAME_DAY: all scans must occur on the same calendar day.

validFrom.description: Barcodes can be scanned from this date onwards

validUntil.description: Barcodes can be scanned until this date.

daysValidAfterPurchase.description: Amount of days a barcode can be validated after its issued date (whole days, timestamp is not taken into account)

shouldValidateTimeslotMoment.description: If set to true a barcode with a timeslot can only be scanned on the (whole) day of the timeslot

minutesBeforeTimeslot.description: Minutes before the timeslot moment a barcode may be scanned. When set (together with/or minutesAfterTimeslot) the scan is validated against an exact time window around the timeslot instead of the whole day. Only applies when shouldValidateTimeslotMoment is true.

minutesAfterTimeslot.description: Minutes after the timeslot moment a barcode may be scanned. When set (together with/or minutesBeforeTimeslot) the scan is validated against an exact time window around the timeslot instead of the whole day. Only applies when shouldValidateTimeslotMoment is true.

shouldValidateOnParent.description: If set to true barcodes will be validated on the top-level parent of the entrance plan.

scanColour.description: Colour (hexcode) that is used on scanner display for successful checkins (Default is green).

requiresPhotoVerification.description: If set to true a successful checkin requires staff to verify the visitor against a photo (e.g. Museumpass Belgium) before it is registered.

requiresConfirmationQuestion.description: If set to true a successful checkin requires staff to answer a confirmation question before it is registered.

confirmationQuestion.description: Question shown to staff when requiresConfirmationQuestion is true.

eventId.description: externalId of event the rule applies to

venueSectionId.description: externalId of venueSection the rule applies to

productId.description: externalId of product the rule applies to

primaryConstraintId.description: externalId of constraint the rule applies to

secondaryConstraintId.description: externalId of constraint the rule applies to

tertiaryConstraintId.description: externalId of constraint the rule applies to
